description: Find public LinkedIn profiles by job title, location, and company using cookieless Yahoo search. Returns name, title, company, location, profile URL, and data-quality flags. No login or API keys.

companyNames.description: Specific companies to target (max 5). Leave empty to search all companies.
companyNames.title: Company Names

includeEmailGuess.description: Add a best-effort email guess derived from name + company domain. Guesses are NOT verified and may be wrong. Off by default.
includeEmailGuess.title: Include Unverified Email Guess

jobTitles.description: Job titles to search for (e.g. 'Software Engineer', 'CEO', 'Marketing Manager'). Each title generates a separate search query.
jobTitles.title: Job Titles

locations.description: Locations to target (e.g. 'New York', 'California', 'United States'). Leave empty to search globally.
locations.title: Locations

maxLeads.description: Maximum number of leads to return (1-100).
maxLeads.title: Max Leads

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy configuration. Yahoo may block datacenter IPs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

title: Lead Finder Input
